Split at 9 August 2025: s. 29 of Act 18 of 2025 added s. 4 (9) (repealed by Act 14 of 2026 from 13 August 2026; its text is not printed in the consolidation) and s. 4 (10) (a document transferring immovable with movable property without valuing each movable item: the tax on the aggregate value), both at the 10 % of Seventh Schedule Part III; s. 4 (11) (additional 10 % duty on non-citizen transfers) runs from 13 August 2026 only. Liability: the transferor (seller); charged on each disposal of the entity's land or buildings (event 'disposal i')
